stepTitle: Consider the function $$f(x)=\cos(x)$$ restricted to the domain $$[\pi, 2\pi]$$. $$Which$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$following$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$graph$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$inverse$$ $$of$$ $$f?$$ \n Three graphs labeled A, B, and C, each showing a curve with domain from negative $$1$$ to $$1$$ on the horizontal axis. Panel A: a decreasing curve from the point negative $$1$$ comma pi to the point $$1$$ comma $$0$$. Panel B: a decreasing curve from the point negative $$1$$ comma $$2\pi$$ to the point $$1$$ comma pi; a vertical shift by pi of the graph in A. Panel C: an increasing curve from the point negative $$1$$ comma pi to the point $$1$$ comma $$2$$ pi.
choices: The function is not invertible, and thus has no graph.
